references.name: Code Slots
references.source_mechanism: One native input with decorative digit slots; keyboard insertion/deletion/selection and paste update the display. External status, not filled length, determines success or rejection.
actual_demo_observations: Opened the default demo and observed 0/6.
Entered three digits, observed three filled slots, then Backspace removed one.
Completed a synthetic six-digit entry and observed Code accepted followed by the demo reset; the exact appended test string is not used as a validation oracle.
Selected Reject and entered a code; observed the subsequent reset, without claiming the transient red rejection frame was captured.
Enabled Disabled and confirmed the textbox was disabled; restored enabled state.
Entered digits and exercised ArrowLeft and Backspace; the filled count changed.
Read the complete JSX, CSS and demo source; the upstream demo uses synthetic delayed outcomes, not a real verification provider.
native_adaptation: static/verification.js: one input preserves native selection, password-manager and one-time-code semantics; six aria-hidden slots mirror it.
Full-width digits and pasted whitespace normalize before native maxlength truncation. Input completion only sets ready, without automatic verification or submission.
Checking, server rejection and real proof success are separate states; success makes the input readonly.
Contact or owner change invalidates proofs; starting resend retires the old proof before new digits may be entered.
static/auth-feedback.js preserves delivery status and help references while owning a separate field error.
static/system/auth.css retains the existing green and light palette, 44px targets, readable helper text, narrow wrapping, reduced-motion and forced-colors fallback.
not_adopted: No React, motion or Hugeicons dependency added.
No copied upstream implementation, automatic submission, fake provider success, six separate tab stops or decorative continuous animation.
references.application_browser_status: defined in scripts/verify_account_lifecycle.mjs; actual new candidate CI remains required

references.name: Rubber Segment
references.source_mechanism: Controlled selection with pointer drag, displacement/velocity behavior, spring motion, keyboard navigation, disabled state and reduced-motion handling.
actual_demo_observations: Observed Week selected by default; clicked Month.
ArrowRight selected Year and Home selected Day, verified by aria-checked.
Enabled Disabled and confirmed the option was unavailable; restored enabled state.
Read complete JSX, CSS and demo source including drag and reduced-motion paths.
unexecuted_demo_paths: Pointer drag and flick motion were read in source but not performed; no claim of verified drag behavior.
references.decision: Reviewed and not adopted for the current login method control. Dragging should not discard an in-progress credential form, and the upstream small default controls do not meet this product target-size requirement. Existing explicit keyboard-focusable login buttons remain.

scope: Two additional references actually inspected; all original 209 catalog identities and adoption decisions remain unchanged. Upstream demo observations and local unit checks do not substitute for the application three-engine CI, physical keyboard/IME, real provider delivery or user server deployment.
